'''Karhel''' was a [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed, along with [[Jaysa Wise]] and a few other SIS agents, in the Imperial-controlled [[High Security Lockdown]] section of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. However, he was apprehended by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] for information on his fellow agents.<ref name="TOR" />
